# @inlang/plugin-message-format 4.5.5 (vendored, MIT)

`dist/index.js` of the npm package, unmodified. Paraglide normally downloads this plugin from
jsDelivr at compile time; it is vendored so builds are offline, reproducible and not exposed to a
CDN. Referenced from `project.inlang/settings.json`. To upgrade: `npm pack
@inlang/plugin-message-format@<version>`, replace `index.js`, update the version here.
